checks.name: Authored Roman numbering and punctuation survive parser and post-processing
Percent paragraph spacing preserves fractional largest-run metrics
Percentage strings use font-relative, not container-relative dimensions
Explicit zero remains zero and malformed percentages are not applied
List-level percent inheritance respects explicit zero and point overrides
Placeholder layout and master paragraph spacing remain distinct
Numbering restarts and continues after Roman/extended alphabetic start values
Roman subtractive notation, case, suffixes and alphabetic rollover are bounded
Repeated post-processing produces the same numbering
Offline parsing and disposal produce no external requests or browser errors
